verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an incident-management SaaS, so the axis applies, but the pack documents no bulk edit, bulk action, or batch API capability. Alert grouping and deduplication merge related alerts into one group. That is a different feature from acting on many selected items at once, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
